_comment: Interface messages. To add a language, copy this file under a new code and translate the values. Do not change the keys. {} is a placeholder.
meta_unknown: WARNING: unknown keys in the instructions header: {0}. Understood keys: {1}. The title and author in the target language are title_target and author_target.
no_head_plain: no headings: the book is split by word count at paragraph boundaries. Normal for continuous prose.
stop_no_head: STOP: no headings found, although the format carries markup.
stop_no_text: STOP: almost no text — {} paragraphs, {} words.
stop_same_lang: STOP: the text is already in the target language ({:.0%} of lines).
same_lang_hint: Nothing to translate. If the book does contain foreign-language passages, run with --force-translate.
nothing_translate: everything was translated earlier ({} chunks), nothing to do
nothing_edit: everything was edited earlier ({} chunks), nothing to do
no_text_hint: This looks like a comic, an art album or a picture book: the text lives inside the images. The pipeline cannot translate that.
no_head_hint: The markup most likely was not recognised, so chunking will fall back to word counts and cut the book mid-scene or between narrators. Translating it in this state is pointless.
no_head_fix_file: 1. Open {0} and look for a style marked "p" where it should be "title". Fix it by hand, delete book.json, run again.
no_head_fix_redo: 2. Or delete {0} and redo detection: ./booktrans BOOK --only structure
no_head_fix_force: 3. If the book really has no chapters, run it with --no-headings
scout_done_already: scouting already done (delete work/scout.md to redo it)
scout_big: WARNING: the reference is oversized and goes into every translation request. Trim {0} by hand, or delete it and redo the scouting pass.
scout_condense: reference too big: {0} chars instead of {1}, condensing ...
scout_condense_no: condensing rejected: {0} of {1} rows lost — keeping the original
preview_left: PREVIEW: {0} blocks left in the source language
sources_head: QUOTATIONS FROM OTHER TRANSLATIONS — {0}, need checking
sources_hint: Check these against the edition: the machine cannot confirm the text came from the source rather than from memory.
usage_note_scout: Scouting and markup detection are not included: they write no chunk files.
usage_note_sub: On a subscription the sum is indicative: this is what API rates would cost.
qa2: 2. NUMBERS  (digits in the source must stay digits)
qa3: 3. PARAGRAPH LENGTH  (an outlier betrays an omission)
qa3_mid: usual length ratio for this book: {0}
qa4_bad: blocks in the source script: {0} (names and titles are usually fine)
qa4_skip: skipped: source and target use the same script ({0})
qa_total: TOTAL remarks: {0}   (blocking ones are sections 1, 2 and 5)
lim_wait: rate limit reached, waiting {0} min (waited {1} min so far)
notes_already: notes were processed earlier ({0} chunks), nothing to do
lim_gave_up: rate limits did not recover within {0} h: {1}
h_desc: Translate a book in a single run (target set by --to)
h_epilog:
examples:
  ./booktrans book.epub --to en
  ./booktrans book.pdf -p glossary.md -o Book.fb2 --to en
  ./booktrans book.epub --only translate --chunks 5,6,7
  ./booktrans book.epub --agent cmd --agent-cmd 'llm -s {system}'

the instructions file (-p) may start with a header:
  ---
  title_target: Usurpation
  author_target: Sue Burke
  series: Semiosis
  series_no: 3
  ---
  ...then free text: what to call the characters, which terms to fix...
h_prompt: file of instructions for the translator
h_prompt_text: instructions for the translator as a string (may be combined with -p)
prompt_nofile: no such instructions file: {0}. If you meant a string of instructions, the option for that is --prompt-text.
h_out: output file: fb2, epub, html or txt (next to the source by default)
h_wait: seconds to wait when rate-limited, 0 to fail instead (900 by default)
h_jobs: threads for editing and notes (translation is always sequential: each chunk builds on the previous one)
h_force: translate even if the book is already in the target language
h_nohead: the book really has no chapters: do not stop at zero headings
h_partial: build the book even if translation is incomplete
h_encoding: input file encoding, when detection got it wrong (e.g. cp1251)
locked:
STOP: a run on this book is already in progress.
  Work directory {0} is held by process {1}.
  Wait for it or stop it, otherwise the chunks will overwrite each other.
scout_unfork: terms with two variants: {0} — picking one each ...
scout_forked: WARNING: the reference gives two variants for {0} terms. Pick one for each in work/scout.md, or the term will drift across the book:
no_summary: WARNING: the chunk came back without a digest. Check that the SUMMARY: and TERMS: labels in the translation prompt were not renamed: without them terminology will drift across the book.
refused: REFUSED: the model stopped twice at block {0}, leaving {1} of {2} untranslated. This is not a markup failure — it is the content of this passage:
refused_hint: Chunk skipped. Translate it with another model, naming its number:  --chunks 16 --agent claude  (what is done will not be paid for twice)
h_fb_agent: agent for chunks the main model refuses
h_fb_model: model for those chunks (defaults to the translation model)
refused_both: the fallback model refused as well at block {0}; chunk skipped
effort_clash:
STOP: agy takes the effort either as a model suffix or as --effort, never both.
  You gave: --model {0} and --effort {1}.
  Keep one: either «{0}», or the model without the suffix plus --effort {1}.
edit_stopped: WARNING: the edits stop at block {0} of {1}, with none after that. It looks like the editor did not finish the chunk — usually a sign of content the model will not handle. Worth re-editing with another model.
no_title: WARNING: no title in «{0}» was found — the book will keep its original title. Add a header to the instructions file:  ---  title_target: Your title  author_target: Author  ---
would_overwrite:
STOP: the output file would overwrite the source: {0}
  Give it another name with -o.
edits_unfinished: UNFINISHED EDITS — {0} chunks where editing broke off
edits_unfinished_item: chunk {0}: edits stop at block {1} of {2}
edits_unfinished_hint: They will not redo themselves: the file is written and resume counts them done. Re-edit with another model:  --only edit --chunks {0} --agent claude --model claude-opus-5
